reviewTriggers: Datatracker publishes a newer draft revision
MCP authorization extension changes the ID-JAG profile requirements
IANA token or grant-profile registrations change
RFC 9700 or OAuth security BCP guidance changes sender-constrained token handling
A target authorization server advertises an incompatible grant profile
requiredRevalidation: diff the draft against the pinned version
update HOBO-48 auth.json pin and HOBO-54 wire vectors in the same review
add or amend adversarial vectors before accepting the new pin
keep older pins unservable for new Bindles unless an upcaster or compatibility note exists

threats.vector: An attacker steals or replays the user identity assertion used to request an ID-JAG.
threats.mitigation: Broker accepts only authenticated, attested HoBo clients, binds nonce and jti, keeps the assertion short lived, and prefers sender-constrained proof when the target profile advertises it.
threats.requiredRegression: stolen assertion replay cannot mint a second ID-JAG

threats.vector: An ID-JAG minted for target A is redeemed at target B or for a different resource indicator.
threats.mitigation: Audience, issuer, resource indicator, client id, and grant profile are all exact-match inputs; mismatches reject instead of narrowing silently.
threats.requiredRegression: audience or resource mismatch returns invalid_grant

threats.vector: A trusted IdP or tenant-scoped issuer is compromised and can sign apparently valid assertions.
threats.mitigation: Trust is tenant-bound and revocable, deny-ceiling policy still caps targets and scopes, grants are short lived, and CredentialAudit supports issuer disablement and forensic replay.
threats.requiredRegression: disabled or wrong-tenant issuer cannot mint or redeem XAA credentials

threats.vector: The requesting app or target AS attempts to widen the redeemed access token beyond inferred usage or policy.
threats.mitigation: Requested scope is the intersection of advertised scope, usage-inferred allow, explicit .allow narrowing, and deny-ceiling policy; the target must narrow or reject, never widen.
threats.requiredRegression: redeemed access token scope cannot exceed manifest allow

threats.vector: HoBo and the target AS implement different ID-JAG draft revisions or grant-profile semantics.
threats.mitigation: auth.json and the wire contract pin one draft string; target metadata must advertise compatible profile support; a newer draft requires a vector-diff review before the pin changes.
threats.requiredRegression: unsupported or mismatched draft version yields hold or invalid_grant

threats.vector: An attacker or stale manifest forces downgrade from oauth2-xaa to oauth2-obo even though XAA is available.
threats.mitigation: Capability discovery prefers oauth2-xaa, mandatory policy may require XAA, fallback is explicit and audited, and downgrade is allowed only when the target does not advertise compatible XAA.
threats.requiredRegression: target advertising XAA cannot be reached through forced oauth2-obo fallback

threats.vector: A request combines a valid subject token with an unrelated or less-trusted actor token to overstate the actor's authority.
threats.mitigation: HoBo rejects actor_token in XAA until a supported profile defines processing; future support must bind actor token, subject, tenant, and policy in one conformance vector.

threats.vector: A DPoP or cnf sender-constrained ID-JAG is silently downgraded to bearer semantics or redeemed with the wrong key.
threats.mitigation: When sender-constrained mode is required, HoBo inspects cnf.jkt, requires a matching DPoP proof, and rejects missing or mismatched proof rather than treating the assertion as bearer.
threats.requiredRegression: cnf-present assertion without matching DPoP proof returns invalid_grant

threats.vector: A refresh token used as subject_token silently expands authorization context or survives longer than the user/app delegation intended.
threats.mitigation: HoBo defaults to identity assertions or OBO SVIDs; refresh-token subject use requires explicit target support, same client binding, same or narrower scopes, and policy approval.
threats.requiredRegression: refresh-token subject cannot widen audience or scopes
